FFmpeg 7.1.5 — "export-ass-zimg" LGPL static build for macOS arm64 + x86_64
STATUS: arm64 BUILT and EXECUTED; catalog row PENDING until its contentSha256 is confirmed by the
        crate's content_identity_file (the value below came from a Python port of content_digest.rs).
        x86_64 BUILT, NOT EXECUTED, NOT APPROVED (catalog row pending; no Rosetta 2 on the build host).
Built 2026-10-11 on an Apple Silicon Mac (macOS 27.0.1, build 26A434; Xcode 27.0 27A266a).

Purpose: the `export-ass` build plus libzimg, so FFmpeg's `zscale` filter exists
(PQ/HLG linearise, bt2020 to bt709, dither) next to `tonemap`; CutRight's HDR and Apple Log to
Rec.709 export path needs it. Everything in BUILD-NOTES-ffmpeg-export-ass-macos.txt applies
unchanged (same pinned FFmpeg, FreeType, FriBidi, HarfBuzz, libass, same configure line, same
meson cross file, same private prefix, same pkg-config confinement); this file records only
what zimg adds. `export-ass` itself is untouched: its rows, digests and licence set keep their
meaning, and this build is a separate variant id.

Recipe: crates/rightkit-media/recipes/build-ffmpeg-macos.sh --variant export-ass-zimg
        (source pin and evidence in recipes/ffmpeg-sources.json, key "zimg").

FFmpeg configure (exact; arm64): the export-ass line followed by --enable-libzimg
  --disable-gpl --disable-nonfree --disable-autodetect --enable-static --disable-shared
  --disable-doc --disable-debug --disable-ffplay --enable-small --arch=arm64
  --cc='clang -arch arm64' --enable-libass --enable-libfreetype --enable-libharfbuzz
  --enable-zlib --enable-videotoolbox --enable-audiotoolbox --pkg-config-flags=--static
  --enable-libzimg
x86_64 is identical except --arch=x86_64 --cc='clang -arch x86_64'
  --enable-cross-compile --target-os=darwin (placed after --cc).
No --enable-gpl, --enable-nonfree or --enable-version3. In FFmpeg 7.1.5's configure libzimg is in
EXTERNAL_LIBRARY_LIST only (configure line 1979), not in the _GPL, _NONFREE, _VERSION3 or _GPLV3
lists, and zscale_filter_deps is "libzimg const_nan" (configure line 3979); vf_zscale.c is
LGPL-2.1-or-later. Configure reports "License: LGPL version 2.1 or later"; config.h CONFIG_GPL 0,
CONFIG_NONFREE 0, CONFIG_VERSION3 0.

zimg 3.0.5 (statically linked; WTFPL)
  Source: https://github.com/sekrit-twc/zimg/archive/refs/tags/release-3.0.5.tar.gz
  sha256  a9a0226bf85e0d83c41a8ebe4e3e690e1348682f6a2a7838f1b8cbff1b799bcf
  Licence: COPYING is the WTFPL version 2 text (Sam Hocevar, 2004). GitHub's licence detection
  reports spdx_id WTFPL. No source file under src/ carries another licence header. Notice file:
  third-party/zimg-COPYING.txt (byte-identical to COPYING at tag release-3.0.5, sha256
  7637386b5f81e8a719ca336233149005e5fa28b5e6054ea7b67de49355b0ad40). WTFPL is permissive: no
  copyleft and no notice duty; the notice is shipped anyway.
  NO UPSTREAM CHECKSUM OR SIGNATURE IS PUBLISHED: the GitHub release has no assets and the
  annotated tag (c6871daee0ab7efecca5211561717f5c0939e100 -> commit
  e5b0de6bebbcbc66732ed5afaafef6b2c7dfef87, 2023-06-30) is unsigned. The pinned value is the
  observed digest of GitHub's generated tag archive (identical from github.com/archive and
  codeload.github.com). Compensating evidence: the archive holds 274 files; the 267 regular
  files are byte-identical (git blob SHA-1) to the tag tree, the other 7 are the tag's symlinks
  (doc/example/misc/*), no file is archive-only, and the only tag entry the archive lacks is the
  test-only googletest submodule. GitHub does not promise archive bytes stay stable, so a future
  mismatch means re-compare with the tag, not blind re-pin.
  Version: 3.0.5 kept for parity with CutRight. 3.0.6 (2025-08-15) fixes only two AVX-512
  numeric bugs (x86; no security advisory is published for the repository: the advisories
  endpoint returns an empty list), so no newer release fixes a security issue.
  Build: the tag archive has no configure script and the host has no autotools, so the recipe
  compiles the library directly from the source lists in the tagged Makefile.am with the flags
  Makefile.am and configure.ac apply (-std=c++14 -O2 -DNDEBUG -fvisibility=hidden, warnings;
  aarch64: -DZIMG_ARM plus the NEON group with no -march flag; x86_64: -DZIMG_X86 plus the
  sse/sse2/avx/f16c/avx2 groups with their -m flags and -mtune hints), archives libzimg.a,
  installs zimg.h, zimg++.hpp and a zimg.pc made from zimg.pc.in with -lc++ as the private C++
  runtime. aarch64 compiles 37 sources, x86_64 48. x86_64 has no AVX-512 kernels: configure.ac
  defines ZIMG_X86_AVX512 only if the compiler takes -mavx512pf/-mavx512er and Apple clang 21
  rejects them ("unknown argument"), the same decision upstream's configure would make here; the
  recipe repeats that probe.

Binaries (retained in vendor/ffmpeg-lgpl/, untracked):

                                       20016472 bytes, contentSha256

Reproducibility: the arm64 build was repeated from scratch in a second work directory and the
two binaries are byte-identical (cmp), as are the notice files. x86_64 was built once.
The binaries contain no build-host path. otool -L (both arches): only /usr/lib/libSystem.B,
libiconv.2, libc++.1, libz.1 and /System/Library/Frameworks/{AudioToolbox, CoreAudio,
ApplicationServices, CoreFoundation, VideoToolbox, CoreMedia, CoreVideo, CoreServices, CoreText}
(libc++ is new against export-ass: zimg is C++; it is an Apple system library).

Verification
  arm64 (executed): -version configuration line = the configure line above; -L = LGPL 2.1 or
    later, no GPL line; `zscale`, `tonemap`, `scale`, `subtitles`, `ass`, `drawtext` and the other
    filters CutRight uses are listed, `eq` (GPL-only) is not. Smoke: a 1 s 640x360 yuv420p10le
    clip tagged bt2020/smpte2084/bt2020nc (ffv1 in Matroska) ran through
    zscale=t=linear:npl=100,format=gbrpf32le,zscale=p=bt709,tonemap=hable,zscale=t=bt709:m=bt709:r=tv,
    format=yuv420p and h264_videotoolbox; the probe shows h264 yuv420p bt709/bt709/bt709, 25 frames;
    mean luma 501.7 (10-bit PQ) became 117.5 (8-bit SDR). The approved export-ass binary lists no zscale.
  x86_64 (NOT executed): static evidence only; config.h CONFIG_GPL/NONFREE/VERSION3 0,
    CONFIG_LIBZIMG 1, CONFIG_ZSCALE_FILTER 1, CONFIG_EQ_FILTER 0, embedded configuration string
    equals the configure line above.

Statically linked components (licence -> notice file):
  everything in BUILD-NOTES-ffmpeg-export-ass-macos.txt, plus
  zimg 3.0.5          WTFPL               third-party/zimg-COPYING.txt
Binary SPDX: LGPL-2.1-or-later AND FTL AND MIT-Modern-Variant AND ISC AND WTFPL

Catalog: WTFPL was approved as a component licence on 2026-10-11 (ALLOWED_COMPONENT_LICENSES in
src/lib.rs, CHANGELOG Unreleased). Rows: ffmpeg-7.1.5-export-ass-zimg-macos-arm64 and
-x86_64, both pending. The variant is new, so the export-ass rows are unchanged and export-ass
consumers see no difference; consumers that need zscale select variant export-ass-zimg
(rightkit_media::EXPORT_ASS_ZIMG_VARIANT, or verify_bundled_ffmpeg).

To reproduce (from rightkit/crates/rightkit-media on a macOS build host):
  recipes/build-ffmpeg-macos.sh fetch --variant export-ass-zimg --sources <src-dir>
  MESON=<venv>/bin/meson NINJA=<venv>/bin/ninja recipes/build-ffmpeg-macos.sh build \
    --variant export-ass-zimg --arch arm64|x86_64 --tool ffmpeg \
    --sources <src-dir> --work <work-dir> --out <out-dir>
